# Poor Accessibility at S-SFX-004 due to Configuration Change on AGG-SFX-01

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-SFX-01`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of the configuration change on the parent aggregation router closely preceding the KPI degradation and alarm onset. Maintenance windows, transport failures, power outages, and external events were explicitly checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-28 01:30 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-28 01:36
- **Affected:** S-SFX-004, S-SFX-001, S-SFX-007, S-SFX-005, AGG-SFX-01

## Summary

Configuration change CHG-2026-0071 pushed RAN parameter template RT-2.4 to aggregation router AGG-SFX-01 at 01:36, negatively impacting admission control and RRC timers across connected sites.

Site S-SFX-004 and other sites connected to AGG-SFX-01 experienced degraded RRC success rates and drop rate spikes starting at 01:30 and continuing through the end of the analysis window.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-28 01:30: Earliest onset of KPI deviation; S-SFX-001 rrc_success_pct below baseline, and ongoing drop rate and RRC success rate anomalies at S-SFX-004. [T9, ALR-0039, ANM-000409, ANM-000410]
- 2026-09-28 01:36: Configuration change CHG-2026-0071 executed on AGG-SFX-01 pushing RAN parameter template RT-2.4. [CHG-2026-0071, T10]
- 2026-09-28 01:54: Minor alarm RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH raised on S-SFX-004. [ALM-000616, T3]
- 2026-09-28 01:57: Minor alarm RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH raised on S-SFX-007. [ALM-000617, T3]

## Evidence

- Detector alert ALR-0039 shows ongoing degradation across 6 sites in region SFX starting at 2026-09-28 01:30. [T1, ALR-0039]
- Topological dependency links S-SFX-004 via LNK-SFX-01-B to parent aggregation router AGG-SFX-01. [T2, S-SFX-004]
- Configuration change CHG-2026-0071 pushed RAN parameter template RT-2.4 to AGG-SFX-01 at 01:36. [T10, CHG-2026-0071]
- KPI query showed deviation across 6 of 6 series including S-SFX-001, S-SFX-004, and S-SFX-007 starting around 01:30. [T9]
- No external events were recorded for region SFX during the incident window. [T12]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-SFX-01: confirmed. Configuration change CHG-2026-0071 was applied to AGG-SFX-01 at 01:36, closely following the onset of KPI anomalies across multiple connected sites, and directly impacting RRC timers and admission control. [CHG-2026-0071, T9, T10]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SFX-01-B: rejected. No transport failures or maintenance events were found on the link or related nodes during the timeframe. [T3, T5]

## Ruled out

- T5: No maintenance windows were scheduled on AGG-SFX-01 or its parents during the incident timeline.
- T12: External events check returned no public holidays, stadium events, or external factors influencing region SFX.

## Recommended actions

- Roll back configuration change CHG-2026-0071 on AGG-SFX-01 to restore previous RRC timers and admission control parameters.
- Monitor RRC success rates and drop rates across all affected sites following any rollback.
